classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: The original supplied Host, Datum, Level, Moduli and Coeff records
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: The exact theorem quantifies over original E,H,Dw,l,Xo,c. Xo.univ.t already includes its group, smooth geometrically connected semiabelian family, action, rigidified cubical line, adjoint identifications and primitive L=B_L(id,w0) identification; Xo.univ includes properness. The theorem does not construct a common Moduli family.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: CNC1 checks the abelian-scheme hypotheses from the original fields. CNC4 normalizes the actual prim/adj line isomorphisms rather than asserting them for an arbitrary symmetric line.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Universal base functions for proper flat connected reduced families
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: If f is proper, flat and of finite presentation and all its geometric fibres are reduced and connected, then O_S -> f_*O_X is an isomorphism after every base change.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: CNC1 verifies these hypotheses for the original universal abelian scheme and all its finite powers, including after nonreduced/nonflat base change. Its normalized line-isomorphism consequence is a written human deduction, not a new retained theorem.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Formal coordinates at a section of a smooth morphism
classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement: A smooth morphism with section has locally a power-series completion along that section, with finite locally free conormal and symmetric conormal associated graded algebra. Nilpotent thickenings of affine schemes are affine.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: CNC3 uses the actual entire free tangent basis from CNC2, then proves the global affine compatible-coordinate construction using successive lifts and associated graded isomorphisms. No local/reduced/Noetherian hypothesis on the coefficient algebra is introduced.

The IsNab member of the old six-premise bundle alone is supplied by CNC15.
